planets.name: L 98-59 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of L 98-59 with a 2.25-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: L 98-59 b was found in 2019 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 5 planets known around L 98-59. Its orbit and size follow Cadieux et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname CADIEUX_ET_AL_2025): disc_year 2019, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 5; pl_orbper 2.25311419, pl_radj 0.07467227, pl_bmassj 0.00144732

quotes.title: L 98-59 b
quotes.card: L 98-59 b is an exoplanet having a size between that of the Earth and Mars and a mass only half that of Venus.
quotes.introduction: It orbits L 98-59, a red dwarf star 34.6 light-years away in the constellation Volans.
